question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR4 durable workflow schema lifecycle layer into core after the prerequisite durable stack lands?
rationale: The implementation creates a new persistent runtime/state boundary and support surface, which is a product and upgrade-compatibility choice beyond a mechanical code review.

options.title: Pause Until Stack Base Is Ready
options.body: Keep the PR open as the PR4 candidate, but require PR1, PR2, and PR3 to settle and then re-review this diff against the final base with upgrade proof.

options.title: Sponsor Durable Core Direction
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the durable core architecture and own the remaining schema, recovery, and operator-surface compatibility review.

options.title: Reject Or Restart Direction
options.body: Close or restart the stack if core durable workflow persistence is judged too heavy or belongs outside core under the current roadmap.

recommendation.title: Pause Until Stack Base Is Ready
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open as the PR4 candidate, but require PR1, PR2, and PR3 to settle and then re-review this diff against the final base with upgrade proof.
